turns.text: Please find the calls with Aunt.
turns.rephrase: I mean: find the calls with Aunt.

turns.gold:
PROCEDURE calls_with(person:PERSON)
$v0 = FIND CALL WHERE SELF.WHO={person}
RETURN $v0
END
turns.name: calls_with
